title: Sparkly cherries
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Glow behind cherries -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='38' ry='30' fill='#1a0a2e' opacity='0.4'/>

  <!-- Stems -->
  <path d='M42 42 Q45 30 52 24' stroke='#7a3a10' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 44 Q55 30 52 24' stroke='#7a3a10' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Stem junction -->
  <circle cx='52' cy='24' r='2.5' fill='#8a4a18'/>

  <!-- Left cherry -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='58' r='15' fill='#e8182c'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='58' r='15' fill='none' stroke='#ff4455' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Shine on left cherry -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='52' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#ff8899' opacity='0.8' transform='rotate(-30 30 52)'/>

  <!-- Right cherry -->
  <circle cx='64' cy='58' r='15' fill='#cc1020'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='58' r='15' fill='none' stroke='#ff4455' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Shine on right cherry -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='52' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#ff8899' opacity='0.8' transform='rotate(-30 58 52)'/>

  <!-- Leaf on top -->
  <path d='M52 24 Q60 16 68 20 Q64 26 54 26 Z' fill='#30c050' stroke='#50e070' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <!-- Sparkle 1 - top left -->
  <g transform='translate(20 30)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-6' x2='0' y2='6' stroke='#ffe040' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-6' y1='0' x2='6' y2='0' stroke='#ffe040' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-4' y1='-4' x2='4' y2='4' stroke='#ffd030' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='4' y1='-4' x2='-4' y2='4' stroke='#ffd030' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Sparkle 2 - top right -->
  <g transform='translate(80 28)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-5' x2='0' y2='5' stroke='#ffe040' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-5' y1='0' x2='5' y2='0' stroke='#ffe040' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-3' y1='-3' x2='3' y2='3' stroke='#ffd030' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='3' y1='-3' x2='-3' y2='3' stroke='#ffd030' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Sparkle 3 - bottom left small -->
  <g transform='translate(16 72)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-4' x2='0' y2='4' stroke='#ffe040' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-4' y1='0' x2='4' y2='0' stroke='#ffe040' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-2.5' y1='-2.5' x2='2.5' y2='2.5' stroke='#ffd030' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='2.5' y1='-2.5' x2='-2.5' y2='2.5' stroke='#ffd030' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Sparkle 4 - bottom right small -->
  <g transform='translate(84 74)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-4' x2='0' y2='4' stroke='#ffe040' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-4' y1='0' x2='4' y2='0' stroke='#ffe040' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-2.5' y1='-2.5' x2='2.5' y2='2.5' stroke='#ffd030' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='2.5' y1='-2.5' x2='-2.5' y2='2.5' stroke='#ffd030' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Tiny dot sparkles -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='22' r='1.5' fill='#fff4a0'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='18' r='1.5' fill='#fff4a0'/>
  <circle cx='12' cy='50' r='1.5' fill='#fff4a0'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='52' r='1.5' fill='#fff4a0'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='78' r='1.5' fill='#fff4a0'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='80' r='1.5' fill='#fff4a0'/>
</svg>
